posts.text: Come on man what the fuck is that. Falling away threes now
I swear in 2 years you’ll be able to put a g league team around this dude and they’ll still win the title.
I kinda like the sherbet tshirt thing the spurs crowd is doing.
That was like the 84th best playoff game in lebrons career but it was complete masterclass. Get everyone involved early, dictate tempo the entire time, defend when needed.

Did LeBron just try to do the magic baby hook across the lane lol right after he did the ‘look at the left hand’ 

Just making reels now
Did Richard Jefferson just call Kennard ‘one of the best 3 point shooters this game has ever seen’
LeBron has played a perfect game so far. Unreal how he can just dig this stuff out of his brain
Feels like Dellavadova is on the court right now lol.
Kuminga change of scenery did not fix the Kuminga stuff

Bron, Kawhi (post contract voiding), jimmy, Draymond, Steph on the warriors next year. Just have one old man team
